recentItems.title: Martin Wolf Speaks On Trump & Nvidia Scandal | Questions Over Power & Corruption | Decoding Now
recentItems.description:
In an exclusive interview with Times Now's Heena Gambhir on Decoding Now, renowned economic commentator Martin Wolf weighs in on the Nvidia controversy surrounding CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement. Wolf calls Trump's intervention an example of "arbitrary despotism" and questions the influence of political power over corporate decision-making. He also discusses allegations of Chinese espionage, national security concerns, potential conflicts of interest, Nvidia's strategic importance in the AI race and the possibility of Trump's impeachment. recentItems.title: Syria Bloodbath: Israel Carries Out Huge Explosion In Overnight Attack? 20 Military Vehicles Roll In
recentItems.description:
Israeli forces set off huge overnight explosion in Tel Ahmar, Syria, after 20+ military vehicles roll in

Israeli forces carried out a huge explosion overnight in Tel Ahmar, in the northern Quneitra countryside of southern Syria, before withdrawing from the area, according to Syrian state television. The blast was heard across several areas, including Deraa, and shattered the windows of nearby residential buildings. No casualties were reported. The explosion came after Israeli forces advanced into Tel Ahmar with more than 20 military vehicles. In this video, we break down what happened, what we know so far, and why this stretch of southern Syria near the Golan Heights remains so sensitive. Watch till the end for the key questions still unanswered. Like, share and subscribe for more world news and Middle East updates.
